summary.result: The results indicate that the FPHM reproduces reservoir inflow dynamics with comparable accuracy to the modified three-tank model, while showing reduced parameter-induced uncertainty under data-limited conditions.
summary.background: Effective management of agricultural reservoirs relies on accurate knowledge of inflow and outflow.
summary.method: The Five-Parameter Hyperbolic Model ( FPHM) is a recently developed lumped hydrological model with a parsimonious structure, but its application to agricultural reservoirs remains limited.
